page.overview:
Who is Monster Girl?

Robot (boyfriend) Rex Splode † Black Samson Shrinking Rae Dupli-Kate Atom Eve Cecil Stedman

Machine Head Kursk Furnace Magmaniac Tether Tyrant Team Evil Invincible:

Amanda, better known by her superhero alias Monster Girl, is a major character in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards.

Originally referred to as Monster Woman, she emerges as an essential member of the new Guardians of the Globe after the massacre of the original team by Omni-Man. Amanda has the capability to change into a formidable, massive creature, significantly enhancing her power and resilience. Yet, this change carries a distinct curse; every time she employs her abilities, her physical form regresses in age, making her look like a young girl even though she is 26 years of age. Once Robot's scientific technology healed her curse, she started to develop feelings for him and their romance blossomed.

Also known as: Amanda Monster Girl.
